key_points: Zacks added HPQ to its Rank #1 Strong Buy list, indicating an upgrade in analyst outlook
UBS revised 2027 PC sales outlook to decline, but notes HP is less exposed than Dell, tempering negative impact
Andra AP fonden disclosed a purchase of ~109k HP shares, suggesting institutional confidence
Several valuation pieces (GuruFocus, simplywall.st) argue HP remains undervalued after recent gains
Rising memory and component costs flagged as a headwind for PC demand, but limited immediate effect on HP
